author: codex-root

findings.summary: The Quick Search trigger is a non-navigating anchor acting as a button.
findings.consequence: The control is keyboard-operable today because Enter and Space handlers are manually duplicated, but future button states can drift from native semantics and tests currently reinforce the less-specific role-button pattern.
findings.evidence: Owned template line 148 starts an `<a>` element with no `href`; lines 150-156 add `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, click, Enter, and Space handling only to emulate a native button. The direct QuickSearch trigger uses the same pattern, and relevant tests locate it by role button rather than asserting a native `<button>`.
findings.recommendation: Render this trigger as `<button type="button" ref="quickSearchTrigger" class="quick-search-trigger" title="Snabbkommando: 's'" @click="openQuickSearch()">Snabbsökning</button>` and keep the existing CSS reset; remove the manual Enter/Space handlers unless parity testing proves a custom behavior is required.
